data.text: God is our refuge and strength, a help readily found in distress.
data.titulo: God Is Our Refuge and Strength
data.subtitulo: For the music leader. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song.

data.text: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and mountains slip into the heart of the seas,
though its waters roar and foam, though mountains tremble at its surging. Selah.
There is a river whose streams gladden the city of God, the holy dwelling place of the Most High.
data.titulo: The City Sustained by God's Presence

data.text: God is in her midst; she will not be shaken. God will help her at the break of dawn.
Nations roar, kingdoms totter; he sounds his voice, and the earth melts.
The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah.
Come, behold the works of the LORD, the desolations he has made on the earth.
He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and cuts the spear apart; he burns the chariots with fire.
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted in the earth.”
The LORD of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold. Selah.
